"Intra-day seasonality and abnormal returns in the Brent crude oil futures market" pdf working paper
searched_not_found.note: No CL/MCL/QM-specific study after 2010 showing out-of-sample or net-of-cost intraday directional predictability at 5 min to session. Closest: USO (Wen et al. 2021 snippet; 2023 in sample), ICE Brent (Haugom et al. 2025, abstract), multi-asset pooled (Safari and Schmidhuber 2025). Nulls: Baltussen et al. (CL OOS R2 -1.04%), Wang and Yang (2010, crude not predictable OOS, pre-2010, abstract). Haugom et al. (2025) accepted manuscript embargoed to 2027-02-06; companion IRFA 2025 paper read (CRUDE-54).

MCL.settlement_basis: financial (cash) against CL final settlement price
MCL.notes: Own spread and touch not sourced. MM program: Micro Crude LPP 2021-07-12..2026-01-31 (CRUDE-4); leader CL volume-incentive programs (CRUDE-25, 26, 46). Retail: ~109,000 individual traders, no share (CRUDE-7). No MCL-CL price-discovery study found.

QM.settlement_basis: financial (cash) against CL final settlement price
QM.notes: Tick 0.025 = 2.5 CL ticks. Own program 2021-2026 not found (2013-15 MMP only, CRUDE-5); leader CL programs CRUDE-25, CRUDE-26. Newer volume: median 4,480.5/day 2025-10..2026-09 (CRUDE-24, F1). Info share vs CL unknown (CRUDE-12).

CL.median_spread_ticks: 1 (volume-weighted, 2012-13; CRUDE-1) | 1.28 (mean of hourly average spreads, US day-session hours, Q1 2023; CRUDE-48)
CL.touch_size: 7 (median level-1 bid depth, 2012-13; CRUDE-2) | about 8 (mean top-of-book quantity, US day hours, Q1 2023; CRUDE-49) | 25 (executable lots at best, 2018; CRUDE-50)
CL.notes: No true session-split median spread sourced; values are a volume-weighted statement (2012-13) and hourly means (Q1 2023). CL volume-incentive programs 2018-02..2025-01, 2024-02..2025-01, 2024-06..2025-01 (CRUDE-25, 26, 46). AT share 35.34% of volume Q1 2010 (CRUDE-55); EMM ~50% 2011 (CRUDE-3). Info share 81.6% vs ICE Brent 2007-12 (CRUDE-32).

gaps: MCL and QM own median spread and touch size: not sourced.
CL spread: no time-weighted median; only a 2012-13 volume-weighted statement and Q1-2023 hourly means from CME (Wayback). Lead decides which, if any, to use as S.
No post-2016 product-level automated/HFT share outside the CFTC series (owned by RatesReader).
QM vs CL price discovery (Tse and Xiang 2005) result unknown.
Halova, Kurov and Kucher (2014), Ye and Karali (2016 journal version), Geman and Li, Haugom et al. (2025), Wen-Gong-Ma-Xu (2021): full texts not obtained; used at abstract, poster or snippet level.
No intraday study of OPEC announcements or of the 2:28-2:30 ET settlement window beyond one event.
2025-12-02 'Modifications to the NYMEX Oil Liquidity Provider Program' filing not read (scope unknown).
Luo and Kang text is a Firecrawl directQuote extraction, not the raw PDF (Cloudflare); Ye and Karali is the 2-page AAEA poster, not the 2016 journal article.
